to: you: only the socket that sent the request

variants.name: Exception
variants.when: A handler threw an exception (the socket wrapper adds 16 to the call cost), or the login of `auth` failed with an exception.

variants.name: Server full
variants.when: `auth`: the server has `max_players` characters. The server checks before and after the login claim.

example.message: Can't accept more than 200 players at this time

variants.name: Claim failed
variants.when: `auth`: the login claim of the character failed. `phrase` is `server.game_error.poker_hand_active` when `reason` is `"poker_hand_active"`, else `server.game_error.authentication_failed`.

example.message: Your poker hand is still running on another server. Wait for it to finish, or reconnect there.

confirm.note: `tx` runs once (no `tries` argument): a thrown error that is not an `ex()` gives the reason `"exception"`.

example.message: Could not confirm your other characters. Please try again.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: Only when the login claim failed: the reason from the claim (an `ex()` call in the claim transaction, or `"exception"` when it threw), also in `phrase_args`.

example.message: Your poker hand is still running on another server. Wait for it to finish, or reconnect there.

senders.what: The socket wrapper: a handler threw an exception, and the call cost is still under the limit. Above the limit the socket gets `limitdcreport` and `disconnect_reason` instead.
The `auth` handler: the server is full, the claim failed, the characters are not confirmed, or an exception.
